subject: Appointment note
text:
Hi all,

Regarding Saturday's appointment, I think the clinic will open on time. I tried logging into the booking page this morning, but it refreshed every few minutes, so I could not confirm the time. Please bring the form we completed last month; it should make the visit shorter. I'll send another note once the appointment appears confirmed.

Thanks,
